jurisdiction: Republic of Korea / South Korea (named place only; never Korea / Seoul metro / ap-northeast-2 alone)

live_book.known_hole: Live book has zero Korea / KOR pins (campuses.json projects=70, country_iso3 KOR=0). Not published this hunt.

method_notes: Sweep of STACK/ESR, Digital Realty, Equinix xScale, PDG, Digital Edge, Keppel, STT GDC, Naver, LG CNS, CapitaLand, Empyrion, LG Uplus, plus MOTIE/MSIT Solaseado/Haenam, Kakao, SK C&C, KT, Samsung SDS, Hostway, Thakral, AirTrunk, Vantage, NTT, CapitaLand siblings, DayOne/GDS, Iron Mountain, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Meta.

Every include:true row fetched via curl from company IR/press/official DC or gov economic-dev naming the place. Grain verbatim. Equinix IBX = hall reject. ESR KR1 Facility Load and PDG SE1 treated as one Bupyeong campus (same Nov 2025 / ~11,000 sqm / 2028 RFS).
Sub-250 disclosed pins stay. Never Seoul metro / ap-northeast-2 / Korea portfolio totals alone. Do not publish. Do not message other agents.
